text: Maya Patel: Quick micro-review for the model catalog compare UI. Focus areas: compact view labels, pin button wording, and perf badge screenreader text. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/compare-2398.png Evan Cho: Compact view tooltip reads 'Compact' today can we make it more descriptive for first-time users? Suggest: 'Compact view — denser rows for quicker scanning'. Rita Singh: +1. Also the pin control label is ambiguous. When focused a screenreader reads just 'Pin'. We should provide context like 'Pin model version (applies model-wide)'. Kara Gomez: Accessibility: use aria-describedby to point to a hidden hint that spells out scope. For the visible label keep it short but on focus expose full text. Evan Cho: For the icon, add title attr and sr-only span: Pin model version: v2.1.0. That way CSV exports can pick it up if we parse DOM later. Maya Patel: Perf badges: collapse to a single compact badge showing p95 by default. Screenreader text should read 'p95 240ms, up 12% vs baseline (7d)'. Avoid relying on color alone for regressions. Rita Singh: Also microcopy: change export modal title to 'Export compare snapshot' and default-check 'Include pin metadata'. We had confusion in support tickets. Kara Gomez: A11y checklist: 1) dense toggle has aria-pressed and is in tab order, 2) pin toggle has aria-pressed + aria-describedby, 3) badge details open via focus (not only hover), 4) contrast for warning color >= 3:1. frontend-bot: Quick preview branch: https://staging.redwood.io/compare/2398-pin-labels with initial sr-only hints and compact tooltip updates. Maya Patel: Action items: - Evan to update compact tooltip copy and add sr-only helper (owner: Evan, due Tue) - Rita to update modal copy + export default (owner: Rita, due Mon) - Kara to run quick a11y sweep on the preview branch (owner: Kara, due Wed) - Frontend to link PR to ticket RD-INF-5312 when ready Maya Patel: Thanks all ":thumbsup"
